title: Oak beams strapped on a small flatbed (top-down)
blurb: Looking down on rough-sawn oak beams and slabs filling a small flatbed deck, two blue ratchet straps across the stack and a green strap at the rear.
photo_credit: Photo: Acabashi, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons. QA sweep development run, Oct 26, 2026.

calibration.axis: x (front at bed_min_x, rear at bed_max_x)
calibration.method: pixels-per-inch from the trailer_bed detection extent
calibration.reason: no trailer_bed detection in this photo, so there is no bed extent to scale from

measurements.name: rear_overhang
measurements.method: rearmost cargo extent (mask bitmap tight edge, else bbox) minus the bed rear edge, scaled by the calibration; rear = image-right end of the bed extent
measurements.reason: no calibration: no trailer_bed detection in this photo, so there is no bed extent to scale from

measurements.name: load_centroid_vs_axle
measurements.method: bitmap-weighted centroid of all cargo masks along the bed axis vs the axle estimate position (midpoint of axle centres when several), scaled by the calibration
measurements.reason: no calibration: no trailer_bed detection in this photo, so there is no bed extent to scale from

measurements.name: tarp_coverage
measurements.method: tarp/canvas mask area overlapping the cargo area, as a percentage of the cargo area (bitmap union on the image canvas)
measurements.reason: load type is 'general', not loose material; the tarp check only applies to loose loads

measurements.name: tiedown_coverage_gaps
measurements.method: tie-down anchor positions mapped onto the bed axis (anchor centre x in bed coordinates); spans between neighbouring anchors and the bed ends, scaled by the calibration
measurements.reason: no tie-down detections in this detection set: tie-downs are counted from anchor close-up photos plus tap-to-correct, and close-up coordinates live in the close-up photo's own image space, so they cannot be placed on this photo's bed axis

notes: calibration unavailable: no trailer_bed detection in this photo, so there is no bed extent to scale from; inch measurements are reported as could_not_measure rather than guessed
load_centroid_vs_axle is a visual estimate of where the load's bulk sits; it is not a weight measurement

verdicts.finding: Forward blocking cannot be judged: there is no calibrated measurement of the load against the bed (no trailer_bed detection in this photo, so there is no bed extent to scale from). Run the measurement stage with the trailer bed length to enable this check.
verdicts.confidence_basis: no calibration: no trailer_bed detection in this photo, so there is no bed extent to scale from

verdicts.finding: This load needs 3 tie-down(s) for its length (14 ft), but no tie-downs could be counted: tie-downs are counted from anchor close-up photos plus any you mark by tapping them on the photo, and neither was supplied. Full-frame photos cannot count straps reliably (they are too thin to read at that distance).
verdicts.confidence_basis: no close-up detection set and no user tie-down marks supplied

verdicts.cfr_citation: 49 CFR Part 393, Subpart I (overhang; lights and plate visibility)
verdicts.finding: Overhang: could not be measured (no calibration: no trailer_bed detection in this photo, so there is no bed extent to scale from). Lights and plate: not checked (needs the rear photo read by the cross-check; segmentation cannot judge whether lights or the plate are obscured).
verdicts.confidence_basis: no measurement and no rear cross-check supplied
verdicts.citation: 49 CFR Part 393, Subpart I (overhang; lights and plate visibility)

verdicts.cfr_citation: 49 CFR 393.100 (load placement; visual estimate only here)
verdicts.finding: Weight placement cannot be called: no calibration: no trailer_bed detection in this photo, so there is no bed extent to scale from. Placement is a visual estimate only in any case - a photo shows where the bulk sits, never how heavy it is.
verdicts.confidence_basis: visual estimate only; no usable centroid measurement
verdicts.citation: 49 CFR 393.100 (load placement; visual estimate only here)

verdicts.finding: Edge protection cannot be judged from the evidence supplied: it needs a close-up of each strap where it crosses an edge, read for protectors. Take an anchor close-up per tie-down and run the cross-check.
verdicts.confidence_basis: no close-up cross-check evidence about straps over edges

verdicts.finding: Tie-down strength cannot be checked from the photo: a photo cannot verify working load limit ratings or load weight, and this check needs both numbers. Missing: no tie-down working load limit ratings were supplied; no load weight was supplied. Supply the load weight and each tie-down's rating and this check runs on those numbers.
verdicts.confidence_basis: not computable: no tie-down working load limit ratings were supplied; no load weight was supplied

report.headline: Need more photos to check 14 ft flatbed load
report.body: Forward blocking could not be told. It needs calibrated measurement against the bed with trailer bed length in the measurement stage. Tie-down count could not be told. This 14 ft load needs 3 tie-downs but none could be counted. It needs anchor close-up photos or taps marking tie-downs on the photo. Overhang could not be measured with no bed extent to scale from. Lights and plate were not checked and need the rear photo read by the cross-check. Weight placement could not be called with no bed extent to scale from and is a visual estimate only. Edge protection could not be judged. It needs a close-up of each strap at each edge plus an anchor close-up per tie-down and the cross-check. Tie-down strength could not be checked. It needs working load limit ratings and load weight. A photo cannot verify strap tension, tie-down ratings, or load weight.
